gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-carrois-gothi: Blunt and loud, each letter alone like a bead on a rod. Carrois Gothic does the talking, modern and generously open in each c, while Impact Label does the commanding.
Heavy and commanding, Impact Label leaves each letter alone like a bead on a rod, its c pinching open. Carrois Gothic SC stays approachable, its curves ending in clear openings.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-duru-sans: Impact Label is heavy, each letter alone like a bead on a rod. Duru Sans lightens the load, modern and clean, its small letters opening wide while their bodies dominate the line.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-gafata: Gafata, contemporary and professional, offers a tall band of letters with short stalks above and wide-eyed lowercase e shapes. Next to heavy Impact Label, that gentleness is the draw.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-georama: Loud and heavy, Impact Label stands each letter alone like a bead on a rod. But Georama keeps things approachable, its wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart and its capitals barely rising.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hedvig-letter: Heavy and commanding, Impact Label stands each letter alone like a bead on a rod, c ends pointing apart. Hedvig Letters Sans, approachable, lets small letters stand almost as tall as capitals.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-heebo: Impact Label is commanding and heavy, each letter alone like a bead on a rod. And Heebo, tall in the middle with curves that stop short, leaves big, short lines to its partner.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hind-guntur: Commanding Impact Label stands each letter alone like a bead on a rod. Hind Guntur would read steadily down a page, modern, with wide gaps at curve ends and no stroke variation.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-hind-madurai: Commanding and heavy, Impact Label sets each letter alone like a bead on a rod, with c ends pointing apart. Hind Madurai does the approachable filling, its s curves open at both ends.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-khula: Loud and heavy, Impact Label keeps each letter alone like a bead on a rod, the c's ends pointing apart. Khula reads smoothly, modern, its curves holding their mouths open.
